This could help explain the leaderboard changes I’ve been seeing on @rarelistio.

My position dropped significantly after the recent updates, and I wanted to understand why. The team now says it fixed a major bug and restored missing RARS to many accounts.

If other contributors were missing points, restoring them could move my position down too. That’s a possible explanation for the movement, though it doesn’t tell me whether my own contributions were counted correctly.

Rarelist also says it has improved its system for filtering low quality content. I’d like to see clearer feedback on which posts count and why others are excluded. That would make it easier to understand a changing score and improve future contributions.

I received my Streamoors early community invite through the campaign, so there’s already a personal reason for me to keep following. Now I’m watching how these fixes translate into more consistent scoring and clearer explanations for creators.
